description: Level 2 — Greetings. Respond to hello, goodbye, and casual greetings. Hooks are particularized per scenario (Case 2): 'you are free to respond to their greeting', 'you are free to respond to their goodbye'.

data.description: Set up word properties for greetings
commands: [repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Noun] hello -> yes
[repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Noun] goodbye -> yes
[repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Noun] hi -> yes
[repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Noun] bye -> yes
[repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Noun] greeting -> yes
[repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Verb] greet -> yes
[repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Verb] welcome -> yes
[repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Verb] reply -> yes
[repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Verb] respond -> yes
[repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Adjective] polite -> yes
[repo] [SET] [Grammar:Property:Word:Adjective] friendly -> yes

data.description: Greeting response — hook: 'you are free to respond to their greeting' (particularized)
commands: [Cond:Reset]
dev says to Susie : if someone greets you
dev says to Susie : if you are free to respond to their greeting
dev says to Susie : then you should greet them back
[Cond:Reset]
dev says to Susie : if someone says goodbye to you
dev says to Susie : if you are free to respond to their goodbye
dev says to Susie : then you should say goodbye back

data.description: Default: when someone says hello to you, you are free to respond to their greeting
commands: [Cond:Reset]
dev says to Susie : if someone says hello to you
dev says to Susie : then you are free to respond to their greeting
[Cond:Reset]

dev says to Susie : then you are free to respond to their greeting
[Cond:Reset]

[Cond:Reset]

data.description: When someone you were already talking to says goodbye — acknowledge the conversation ending
commands: [Cond:Reset]
dev says to Susie : if someone says goodbye after a conversation
dev says to Susie : if you enjoyed talking with them
dev says to Susie : then you should say you enjoyed talking to them

commands: [Cond:Reset]
